Experience matters

Your tile showroom in south west Sydney

Since 2000, Bonnyrigg Tiles has supplied quality tiles for residential and commercial projects across Sydney and the surrounding areas. Whether you are updating one bathroom or supplying a large development, we carry stylish, durable tiles to suit your design and your budget.

Our team works with homeowners, builders and designers every day, so you get practical advice on tile selection, design ideas and installation from people who know the product.

Good to know

Questions we hear in the showroom

Can't see your question here? Call us on (02) 8786 0288 and our team will help.

View all FAQs
Where is the Bonnyrigg Tiles showroom and when is it open?

Our showroom is at 43-45 Bonnyrigg Avenue, Bonnyrigg NSW 2177, in Sydney's south west. We are open Monday to Friday from 7am to 5pm and Saturday from 7am to 3pm. We are closed on Sundays.

How do I order tiles from the website?

Add the tiles and products you are interested in to your enquiry cart, then send them through as a single enquiry with your details. No payment is taken online. Our team will get back to you to confirm availability and final pricing.

What are BT Specials?

BT Specials are the tiles Bonnyrigg Tiles imports directly, together with our clearance lines. You can browse the full range on the BT Specials page or see them in person at the showroom.

Can I see a tile in a room before I visit?

Yes. Our tile visualiser lays the tile across a bathroom, kitchen or alfresco floor so you can compare sizes, layouts and grout colours. Screens vary, so we still recommend seeing your shortlist in the showroom before you order.

Do you deliver tiles in Sydney?

Yes, we offer Sydney metro delivery. Include your suburb when you send your enquiry and our team will confirm delivery to your area. You are also welcome to collect from the showroom, and our vehicle loading policy explains how collection and loading work.

Do you sell more than tiles?

We do. Alongside floor and wall tiles we stock bathroom ware, tapware and kitchen sinks, plus tiling tools and building supplies such as tile adhesive, grout, waterproofing, sand and cement.
